documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Closure of Buy Back
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Bajaj Auto Limited reported record financial performance for Q1 FY27, with total revenue crossing INR 17,000 crores and EBITDA reaching INR 3,596 crores, driven by strong volumes across domestic and export markets. Management noted significant challenges from hyperinflationary commodity costs, fuel availability issues, and supply chain disruptions, which were mitigated through calibrated pricing actions, dollar realization, and cost control. The company is actively planning a capacity expansion of nearly 25% from 7 million units to 9 million units per annum to address rising demand, particularly in electric vehicles and high-end motorcycles. Furthermore, the company is executing a comprehensive portfolio makeover in domestic motorcycles, especially in the 125cc-plus segment, aiming for enhanced market competitiveness. Bajaj Auto reported record financial and operational performance for Q4 and FY26, driven by growth across all business units, a robust export performance despite regional disruptions, and strong demand in domestic sports motorcycles and electric vehicles.

guidance.claim: Management expects the motorcycle category growth to slow down to 7% to 9% in the near term.
guidance.quote: This is bound to slow down the motorcycle category from its rocking 20% growth in Q4 to we estimate 7% to 9% in the near term.

guidance.claim: The company expects its export volume to move to 2,20,000-plus units per month in the current quarter.
guidance.quote: We are looking at moving the exports needle to 2,20,000 units per month this quarter, up from the 2,00,000 levels.

guidance.claim: Material cost inflation is estimated to be approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue.
guidance.quote: Taken together, we are currently estimating a material cost inflation impact of approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand environment across both domestic and international key markets is very positive.
demand_outlook.quote: Having said that, the demand environment, both in domestic and international, particularly in our key markets, is very positive, though the business environment may still be a bit volatile.

demand_outlook.claim: The domestic motorcycle industry had a split trajectory in FY26, featuring a muted first half followed by a strong second half.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic motorcycles, the industry had a split trajectory in FY '26 with a muted first half, followed by a strong recovery in the second half.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment softened in April due to general inflation, increased vehicle prices, LPG shortages, and manpower migration.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment, it has softened in April due to general inflation, increased prices of our vehicles, LPG shortages, manpower migration and the LPG shortage-led effect on the consumer sentiment.

demand_outlook.claim: Latin America continues to outperform, delivering sustained growth for 11 consecutive quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: Latin America continues to outperform, delivering sustained growth for 11 consecutive quarters now and reporting another all-time high performance, driven by strong growth in almost each and every country.

demand_outlook.claim: The electric scooter segment grew by 40% in Q4 and continued to grow at over 60% in April.
demand_outlook.quote: The E-segment, scooter segment grew by 40% in Q4 and has continued to grow at an even higher rate of 60% plus in April, far outpacing the growth of ICE scooters.

demand_outlook.claim: The company notes that India continues to be one of the world's fastest growing major economies, with almost unparalleled long-term potential across both domestic consumption and electric mobility.
demand_outlook.quote: India continues to be one of the world’s fastest growing major economies, with almost unparalleled long-term potential across both domestic consumption and electric mobility.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the uptick and rebound across overseas markets augurs well for the company as a foremost exporter from the country.
demand_outlook.quote: The uptick/rebound across overseas markets augurs well for your Company that is a foremost exporter from the country and a shining example of a Company that not just Makes in India for India but also Makes in India for 100+ countries the world over.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum to 9 million units per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: So, with an eye on the future, we are undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum across different businesses to progressively go up to 9 million units per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: Key areas for capacity expansion will include electric vehicles for two-wheelers and three-wheelers, high-end motorcycles, and three-wheelers.
capex_expansion.quote: The key areas to address will be EVs, both two-wheelers and three-wheelers, high-end motorcycles and three-wheelers.

capex_expansion.claim: Manufacturing capacity in Brazil has increased to 60,000 units per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Sales nearly 10,000 units during the quarter, supported by expanded manufacturing capacity, which has now increased to 60,000 units per annum, successful new product introductions like the 400 NS and wider market presence with almost 70 top-class stores.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capex for the year was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex for the year was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested meaningfully across strategic priorities, notably growing its presence in electric mobility, scaling up its financing business through Bajaj Auto Credit, sharpening R&D capabilities through Bajaj Auto Technology, and acquiring and assuming control over the KTM group.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, your Company invested meaningfully across strategic priorities — notably on growing its presence in electric mobility, scaling up its financing business through Bajaj Auto Credit, sharpening its R&D capabilities through Bajaj Auto Technology, acquiring and assuming control over the KTM group, while widening its portfolio/footprint to leverage both domestic and international growth opportunities.

margins_costs.claim: Commodity inflation intensified during the quarter, taking the overall impact to about 4.5% of revenue.
margins_costs.quote: Through the quarter, commodity inflation intensified even further. Inflation across the metals complex accelerated meaningfully through May, taking the overall inflationary impact for the quarter to about 4.5% of revenue.

margins_costs.claim: Calibrated pricing actions implemented through April and June enabled the company to offset nearly about half of the inflation.
margins_costs.quote: That said, we also responded decisively. And as I had indicated in the previous call, we responded with calibrated pricing very judiciously taken through April and June, enabling us to offset nearly about half of the inflation through pricing.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins inched up to 20.9%, representing a sequential improvement of 10 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins inched up to 20.9%, an improvement of 10 basis points sequentially despite the hyperinflationary commodity environment that I'd spoken about.

margins_costs.claim: Chetak transitioned from being EBITDA neutral to becoming EBITDA positive.
margins_costs.quote: So, we now have the contribution of an EBITDA positive on Chetak in addition to the growing scale of the electric three-wheeler that is leading to an overall portfolio margin of double digit.

margins_costs.claim: The electric portfolio hit double-digit EBITDA margin in its entirety for the first time during the year.
margins_costs.quote: Underpinning the margin delivery was a significant development that we have made on our electric portfolio, which hit double-digit EBITDA margin in its entirety for the very first time in the course of this year.

margins_costs.claim: Net cost inflation came in at about 40 basis points after taking pricing actions during the fourth quarter.
margins_costs.quote: And therefore, net cost inflation came in at about 40 basis points. This is after taking pricing.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA crossed 12,000 crore for the first time while EBITDA margins remained robust at 20.5 percent.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA crossed H 12,000 crore for the first time, while EBITDA margins remained robust at 20.5%, reflecting the disciplined and dynamic P&L management through the year, where every lever of judicious pricing, cost savings/ efficiencies, richer mix and operating leverage was brought into action to sustain the industry-leading margin performance alongside making competitive investments.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity issues restricted sales of some models both in India and overseas.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity issues restricted sales of some models, both in India and overseas.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacities have emerged as a key constraint to growth for the business.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacities have emerged as a key constraint to growth.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volumes for Q4 reached a new high of 13.7 lakh units, growing 24% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Total volumes reached a new high of 13.7 lakh units, growing 24% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Chetak crossed the 1 lakh retail mark for the very first time in a single quarter during Q4.
orders_capacity.quote: In Chetak, the electric scooter business, in quarter 4, Chetak crossed the 1 lakh retail mark for the very first time in a single quarter, the highest ever quarterly retails for the brand.

orders_capacity.claim: The commercial vehicle business crossed the 5-lakh unit mark for the full year for the first time.
orders_capacity.quote: For the first time in our history, the commercial vehicle business crossed the 5-lakh unit mark for the full year, a milestone that reflects both our ICE leadership and the scaling up of our electric portfolio.

orders_capacity.claim: The company scaled new heights during the year, delivering its highest-ever annual volumes at over 5 million units.
orders_capacity.quote: Your Company scaled new heights during the year, delivering its highest-ever annual volumes at over 5 million units, overtaking its previous peak set several years ago.

orders_capacity.claim: Assets Under Management of Bajaj Auto Credit grew roughly 2 times to 18,835 crore as of March 31, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Assets Under Management grew ~2X to H 18,835 crore as of 31 March 2026, Total Income stood at H 3,248 crore, up >3X and Profit After Tax at H 665 crore surged >11X, all over previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated over INR 2,300 crores of free cash flow during the quarter, achieving a cash conversion of nearly 80% of profit after tax.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated over INR2,300 crores of free cash flow during this quarter, almost double that of the same period last year, translating into a cash conversion of almost 80% of profit after tax.

capital_allocation.claim: The balance sheet remains healthy with surplus cash in excess of INR 21,000 crores at the end of the June quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: The balance sheet continues to remain very healthy with surplus cash in excess of INR21,000 crores at the end of the June quarter, well managed and providing sufficient fuel for future growth investments, strategic opportunities and improved shareholder returns.

capital_allocation.claim: Surplus funds closed the year at over INR18,000 crores after deploying capital on multiple fronts.
capital_allocation.quote: We closed the year with surplus funds of over INR18,000 crores after deploying capital on multiple fronts during the year, reflecting a strong and consistent cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash flow for the year was more than INR8,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Free cash flow for the year was more than INR8,000 crores, a reflection of the very robust cash conversion on profit.

capital_allocation.claim: The board approved a payout of 100% of the profits made last year, split between a final dividend of INR150 per share and a buyback.
capital_allocation.quote: Lastly, the Board of Directors at its meeting earlier today approved a payout of 100% of the profits that we have made last year in recognition of the 100 years milestone of the Bajaj family in India and with Bajaj Auto being the flagship company that started it all. his will be split as follows a final dividend of INR150 per share that will aggregate to INR4,192 crores and the balance of about INR5,633 crores will be towards a buyback under the tender route at a buyback price of INR12,000 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintained a very healthy balance sheet with surplus cash of over 18,000 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Free Cash Flow generation remained exceptionally strong at over H 8,000 crore, reflecting the robust cash conversion of your Company that enables it to continue investing behind future growth opportunities while maintaining a very healthy Balance Sheet with surplus cash of over H 18,000 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved a payout of 100 percent of the Profit after Tax for the year to shareholders through a combination of dividend and share buyback amounting to nearly 10,000 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: In recognition of the Bajaj Group’s centenary year and Bajaj Auto’s position as the flagship Company, the Board approved a payout of 100% of the Profit after Tax for the year to shareholders, through a combination of dividend and share buyback, amounting to nearly H 10,000 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: Surplus cash and cash equivalents as on March 31, 2026 stood at 18,137 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Surplus cash and cash equivalent as on 31 March 2026 at J 18,137 crore, which was 6.7% more than previous year, after investing ~ J 500 crore in CAPEX, J 2,300+ crore in strategic bets (BACL and BAIH BV) and ~ J 5,900 crore to shareholders as dividend.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operations were suspended for a few days due to a ransomware attack while exercising abundant caution.
risks_headwinds.quote: It was a tough quarter with RM inflation, supply chain and logistics disruptions as well as a ransomware attack, which you may have read about, but it was defended comprehensively and successfully. Though exercising abundant caution, we suspended operations for a few days to complete thorough checks and investigations.

risks_headwinds.claim: Disruptions impaired availabilities by about 10% to 15%, particularly affecting exports, high-end bikes, and EVs.
risks_headwinds.quote: All of these above issues combined impaired availabilities by about 10% to 15%, more so in exports, high-end bikes and EVs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain difficulties regarding LPG shortages, manpower availability, and outbound logistics impaired service availability by about 10% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Supply chain difficulties in terms of the LPG shortage, manpower availability and outbound logistics to overseas markets have impaired availability to service demand by about 10% to 15%.

risks_headwinds.claim: The cost environment is seeing a potential rise of about 3% to 5% driven by the metal complex.
risks_headwinds.quote: The cost environment is seeing a potential rise during the quarter of about 3% to 5%, driven by the metal complex.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the external environment is marked by heightened geopolitical uncertainty, commodity inflation, supply chain disruptions, and a rapidly shifting global environment.
risks_headwinds.quote: In a year marked by heightened geopolitical uncertainty, commodity inflation, supply chain disruptions and a rapidly shifting global environment, your Company delivered its best-ever financial and operating performance.

risks_headwinds.claim: Non-availability of rare earth magnets caused supply disruption in the first half for the Chetak business.
risks_headwinds.quote: Non-Availability of rare earth magnets, a consequence of export restrictions from China, created supply disruption in the first half, constraining volumes even as consumer demand remained strong.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to accomplish an exhaustive portfolio makeover in the 125cc segment within the next 6 weeks.
management_commitments.quote: Our aim is to accomplish this exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next 6 weeks.

management_commitments.claim: The export business is looking at moving exports beyond the 250,000 per month level this quarter and onwards.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, the exports business, which like I said is 40% of our revenue, has established an outstanding growth momentum and we are looking at moving exports to beyond the 2,50,000 per month level this quarter and onwards.

management_commitments.claim: New product ranges in both the 125cc and 150cc plus segments will hit the market starting in July under the Pulsar brand.
management_commitments.quote: There will be hopefully, I think we will see these new introductions hitting the market as early as July in the Pulsar brand itself.

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to move BMAG and KTM AG to quarterly reporting as a voluntary action starting next year.
management_commitments.quote: Going forward, it is our intention to move BMAG, KTM AG to quarterly reporting as a voluntary action to align with Bajaj Auto's reporting calendar and as a measure of good governance and transparency.

management_commitments.claim: The company proposes to pay commission to non-executive directors for a further period of five years up to and including the year 2030-31.
management_commitments.quote: In view of the substantial rise of non-executive directors’ participation at the Board and Committee meetings and the higher responsibilities they are expected to bear on account of statutory & regulatory requirements, it is proposed to continue to pay such commission to the non-executive directors for a further period of five years upto and including the year 2030-31.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
